segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Good morning team. Let's do our release readiness review. What is the status of the authentication bug?

segments.speaker: George
segments.text: I've been looking into it. Users are experiencing login failures due to an expired token management issue.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: I confirmed the issue during QA testing. We have a temporary workaround, but the permanent fix will take two days.

segments.speaker: George
segments.text: I'll take ownership of the permanent login patch and complete it by Friday at 5 PM.

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Approved. We decide to deploy the temporary workaround today, and George will release the permanent patch Friday.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: I will notify the customer support team about the known issue by 2 PM today.

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Excellent. Ravi handles support notifications, George patches login by Friday. Let's wrap up.

decisions: Deploy the temporary authentication workaround today
Release the permanent login patch on Friday
